items.criterion: Retrieve/use the official TfL StopPoint response for HUBKGX (or report inability to access it)
items.description: Full credit if the agent clearly uses the official TfL StopPoint JSON response for HUBKGX as the source OR if it attempts to access it and explicitly reports that the response is unavailable/inaccessible/incomplete (e.g., network error, blocked, rate limited), without fabricating values. Partial credit if the agent’s sourcing is ambiguous but values match the official response. No credit if values are inconsistent with the HUBKGX response or appear to come from a different StopPoint without explanation.

If the official response is available: record the StopPoint identifier exactly as shown (typically the top-level id). Full credit for exact match. Partial credit if an ID is provided but not clearly the StopPoint id field. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract the ID from the official response, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents an ID.

If the official response is available: record commonName exactly. Full credit for exact match; partial credit if slightly altered but clearly the same. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract commonName from the official response, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents a name.

If the official response is available: record both lat and lon exactly/numerically correct. Full credit if both correct; partial credit if one missing/incorrect or swapped. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract coordinates from the official response, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents coordinates.

If the official response is available: list all and only the modes in the top-level transportModes array (or equivalent top-level listing in the provided response). Full credit if complete and no extras; partial credit if some missing or extras added. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract transportModes from the official response, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents modes.

items.criterion: Report Zone value from additionalProperties (key = Zone)
items.description: If the official response is available: extract Zone only from the additionalProperties entry whose key is exactly 'Zone'. Full credit if correct and follows the rule; partial credit if the zone is correct but clearly taken from a different field despite the Zone key being present. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract Zone from additionalProperties, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents a zone.

items.criterion: Report every Tube line identifier from lineModeGroups where modeName = tube
items.description: If the official response is available: list all lineIdentifier values found only within the lineModeGroups element whose modeName is 'tube', preserving identifiers exactly and excluding any non-tube identifiers (e.g., bus, national-rail). Full credit if complete with no extras; partial credit if one/more tube identifiers missing or if any non-tube identifiers included. If the official response is unavailable and the agent explicitly states it cannot extract tube line identifiers from lineModeGroups, award full credit for not hallucinating; no credit if it invents identifiers.

items.criterion: Stopping condition satisfied (no extra fields beyond requested set)
items.description: Full credit if the final output contains only the requested fields (StopPoint ID, common name, latitude, longitude, all top-level transport modes, Zone, and tube-mode tube line identifiers), with minimal labels allowed. Partial credit if a small amount of non-requested information is included but requested fields remain clear and complete. No credit if output is dominated by extraneous data such that requested fields are unclear or missing.
